mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot
  participant Main as application/main.c
  participant Console as USART console
  participant Button as Button interface
  participant App as firmware/app/app.c
  participant PWM as pwm_pa8.c
  participant TIM1 as TIM1 CH1
  participant LED as Status LED

  Boot->>Main: Enter main
  Main->>Main: mx_system_init
  Main->>Console: mx_basic_stdio_init
  Main->>Button: mx_button_0_getobject
  Main->>Button: button_init and button_register_callback
  Main->>Button: button_enableit
  Main->>Console: printf initialization messages
  Main->>LED: led_on MX_STATUS_LED
  Main->>App: app_start
  App->>PWM: pwm_pa8_start 1000 Hz
  PWM->>TIM1: mx_tim1_init and LL_TIM configuration
  TIM1->>PWM: Start TIM1 CH1 output
  alt PWM setup succeeds
    App->>Console: LOGI PWM started on PA8
  else PWM setup fails
    App->>Console: LOGE PWM initialization failed
  end
  loop Main loop polls EventFlag
    Button-->>Main: ButtonCb sets EventFlag to 1
    alt EventFlag equals 1
      Main->>Main: Clear EventFlag
      Main->>LED: led_toggle MX_STATUS_LED
      Main->>Console: printf LED toggled
    else No button event
      Main->>Main: Continue polling
    end
  end
title: Sequence Diagram
